title: Cover your full-back
brief: Their #8 is about to play the ball out wide to their winger.
briefKid: Their midfielder is about to pass out wide.
question: Your full-back is going to their winger. Where do you go?
questionKid: Your teammate is going to their winger. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: When your full-back goes to the ball, drop in behind them at an angle, a few metres deeper and nearer the middle, ready to step in if they are beaten.
takeaway.kid: Teammate goes to the ball? Back them up from behind, nearer the middle.

misconceptions.text: You went to the ball as well, so if their winger beats your full-back there is nobody behind to stop them.
misconceptions.textKid: If you both go to the ball, nobody is there to back up.

misconceptions.text: You stayed in the middle, which leaves a big gap between you and your full-back for their winger to run into.
misconceptions.textKid: You are too far from your teammate, so move across to help.
